tickets.title: Lumina 55 Pro shows error E-715 with game console
tickets.description: The Voltara Lumina 55 Pro shows error E-715 (HDMI 2.1 FRL link training failed) when the PS5 is connected at 4K 120 Hz. Picture drops every few minutes.

tickets.title: OLED O65 shows LX-90 pixel refresh interrupted
tickets.description: The Lumenix OLED O65 shows error LX-90 every morning; faint ghost images of news tickers.
